provenance.line: log_to_json, and the assertions in test_log_event_with_value
provenance.producer: dfe-receiver, Vector gRPC transport, Log event
provenance.note: log_to_json returns the sender's value map verbatim -- no _vector_type, no _source, nothing added. Logs are the common case on this transport and the one shape it never tags, so the gRPC blind spot is the larger half, not the corner.
